name: Pi Agent Task
description: Service task executed by the Pi coding agent harness (app/adapters/pi_client.py).

properties.label: Agent role
properties.description: Role/prompt variant Pi runs for this task, e.g. planner, implementer, reviewer, assistant.

properties.label: Instructions (input)
properties.description: Process variable mapped in as the task's free-form instructions.

properties.label: Status (output)
properties.description: Process variable to publish the harness result's `status` field to.

properties.label: Summary (output)
properties.description: Process variable to publish the harness result's `summary` field to.
